title: Canonical evaluation harness
description:
Implement the canonical evaluation harness agreed on KDATAP-77d2b0: one representation, one eligibility model, one evaluator, one four-layer scorecard.

Scope is the code half of the contract. Gold migration is KDATAP epic "Corpus gold migration"; the frozen baseline is the baseline epic. Detector retuning and new language ingest remain out of scope — with 15 PII rules, 422 of 793 mention and data-item gold cases have no concept to detect at all, so tuning against current scores optimizes the alias table.

Three rulings on the design epic gate B1, B12 and the adapters: the per-layer meaning of `subject.name`, when instance/vendor is required on a component expectation, and the data-flow disposition.

Definition of done: every headline metric is produced by one evaluator consuming canonical observations from shared adapters; `tests/benchmark/precision.ts` no longer owns matching rules; the contract suite passes on synthetic golden inputs.
